'''HarrGick''' was a [[Gender|male]] [[Ugor]] who worked in a factory owned by [[Ubrikkian Industries]] in [[Coronet City]] on the [[planet]] [[Corellia]]. After more than a [[Standard decade|decade]] of service, he was laid off<ref name="SoloOG" /> in [[13 BBY]]<ref name="Date">''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story The Official Guide]]'' dates the events in ''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story]]'' that take place on the planet [[Corellia]] to six years after the [[Proclamation of the New Order|formation]] of the [[Galactic Empire]]. ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' dates the formation of the Empire to [[19 BBY]], therefore the events on Corellia in ''Solo'' must take place in [[13 BBY]].</ref> when the [[Galactic Empire]] took over the factory.<ref name="SoloOG" /> HarrGick and another individual wearing the same [[Color|blue]] and white [[humanoid]] [[Environment suit|spacesuit]] and [[atmosphere]] containment [[Hat|helmet]] were present in [[Coronet City Spaceport|Coronet Spaceport]], where they approached Imperial [[Corporal]] [[Zuzanu Latt]] at one of the [[spaceport]]'s terminals.<ref name="Solo">''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
HarrGick first appeared in the [[2018]] film ''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story]]''<ref name="Solo" /> and was first identified in the accompanying book ''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story The Official Guide]]'', which was written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]].<ref name="SoloOG" />
